card.title: Obey Without Explanation
card.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave your desk and stand by that open window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need to know whether my team follows a direct request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's freezing. Can I get my coat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Fetch mine too, then come back and hold it while I check the rest of the team.

beats.text: Leave your desk and stand by that open window.

beats.text: I need to know whether my team follows a direct request.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's freezing. Can I get my coat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Fetch mine too, then come back and hold it while I check the rest of the team.

mechanism: A uses an uncomfortable position and an expanded coat errand to test progressively more inconvenient compliance.
confusable: Unlike practical workplace direction, A must explicitly make following the request the reason for the burden.
comparison: D59-b adds personal service to relief from cold; D59-a adds pointless return and silence after initial compliance.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
